interface.title: Storm Drainage Calculation
interface.stage_of_work: Preliminary design calculations, for teaching and early design (the README says to check results against local standards before final design)
interface.what_it_is_for: A static browser workbench (Arabic right-to-left interface with English engineering terms) that takes a drainage engineer from project identity and raw rainfall through to an Annual Maximum series, a Gumbel IDF table, a design intensity, SCS-CN runoff, design-storm hyetographs and Rational Method peak flow, then a results dashboard with CSV, PNG and project-file exports. It does not size conduits (no Manning or pipe design).

data.note: Only built-in examples were used: the project 'Sample data' button, the Raw Rainfall 'example raw data' (8 years of hourly records, 3781 rows) and the 'Annual Max template' (10 years), the IDF 'teaching example' table (11 durations × 6 return periods), the IDF coefficient example and the 90-pattern Rainfall Designer library. No test files were available to upload. Open-Meteo and NASA POWER fetches were not run because they need outside servers; I only built and copied the request URL.

screens_never_reached: A printable report view or print button. app.js defines generateReportPreview, printSelectedReport and downloadReportHTML (app.js:133-167, per the review's code reading), but no element in index.html calls them, so the README's 'browser print workflow and configurable report preview' cannot be reached from the interface. The browser's own print preview can't be seen headless either.
Results dashboard with '—' placeholders for uncalculated modules: Reset recomputes defaults instead of blanking them, so this state never appeared
An Open Project file picker loaded with a .stormweb file: no test files were available to upload
not_done: Uploading a raw rainfall CSV/TXT, an IDF CSV ('استيراد CSV/TXT') or a .stormweb project: no test files were provided
Fetching Open-Meteo or NASA POWER data ('جلب بيانات أونلاين'): it needs servers outside 127.0.0.1:8000; I only built and copied the request URL

Printing or previewing a report: the report-preview, print and HTML-report functions exist in app.js (app.js:133-167) but have no button in index.html, and the browser print dialog isn't available headless

Reading an interpolated design intensity: Tc 12 was typed in table mode and the helper said it would be interpolated, but no resulting I was captured (the next result shown, 119.43 mm/hr, was in coefficient mode)
Hover tooltips on chart points: hovering the IDF chart showed nothing (screens/014.webp)

Observations to check: (1) the 'IL Huff 0-10sm 2Q' pattern came out front-loaded and decaying, with its peak in the first interval rather than the second quartile (screens/025.webp). Per the review's code reading this is a code bug, not a data issue: shapeFraction tests p.includes('huff') before the quartile checks (app.js:60), so every Huff pattern gets u^0.55 and is front-loaded whatever its quartile (only the 2Q pattern was viewed in this run); (2) the table checker silently dropped a row with a non-numeric cell ('abc') rather than flagging it (screens/032.webp); (3) the dashboard card labelled 'IDF max Intensity' shows the design I at Tc, not the table maximum; (4) the English setting translates only the sidebar and headings, and body text stays Arabic (screens/028.webp)
